title: Rackspace Spot breach with leaked credentials let attackers read customer Kubernetes Secrets
date_note: Day of the unauthorized access as given in Rackspace's customer notification, reported by BleepingComputer on November 21, 2026; Rackspace learned of it on November 18.
place: United States (location not stated in the source)
geo_basis: country only; the article gives no location for the affected platform
summary: According to a Rackspace notification to affected customers obtained by BleepingComputer, an unauthorized party used leaked credentials to access parts of Rackspace Spot on November 17, 2026 and could create pods, read Kubernetes Secrets and list nodes and volumes. Rackspace learned of it on November 18 from a customer report. Techzine reports that Rackspace is shutting Spot down on December 8, 2026.
plain: Hackers used leaked logins to get into Rackspace's Spot cloud service and could read secrets some customers stored there. Techzine reports Rackspace is shutting Spot down on December 8, 2026.
exec: Secrets in hosted Kubernetes clusters were readable by attackers, and Techzine reports Spot shuts down on December 8, 2026, so customers must rotate credentials and migrate.
action: Rackspace's notice, as reported by BleepingComputer and Techzine, tells Spot customers to treat API and refresh tokens as compromised, rotate credentials in cluster Secrets, review logs for the listed indicators, and migrate and download data before December 8.
impact: Number of affected customers not disclosed; Rackspace did not answer BleepingComputer's question as of its article on November 21, 2026.

sources.name: BleepingComputer: Rackspace Spot breach let hackers access customer Kubernetes secrets
Techzine Europe: Rackspace discontinues Rackspace Spot following a security incident

key_findings: An unauthorized party used leaked credentials to access parts of Rackspace Spot on November 17, 2026.
Attackers could create pods, read Kubernetes Secrets and list nodes and volumes in some customer organizations.
Rackspace revoked affected tokens and sessions, removed unauthorized pods and rotated keys; it announced full restoration on November 21.
recommendations: Reissue Spot API and refresh tokens, download fresh kubeconfig files, rotate credentials in cluster Secrets, review logs back to November 17.

evidence.quote: on November 17, 2026, between approximately 00:20 and 22:00 UTC

validation.note: BleepingComputer only, quoting Rackspace's customer notification it obtained; no Rackspace-hosted notice was found and the r/rxt_spot posts the article links (reddit.com) could not be loaded.
